selected.title: CADForge: Agentic Single-View CAD Reconstruction with Explicit Geometry Reasoning
factual_points: Converts a single image into editable CadQuery programs using an agentic pipeline.
Decomposes objects into CAD components, infers constraints and translates them into modeling parameters.
A review agent inspects geometry and gives iterative refinement feedback.
Adds failure-guided tool construction and compact parametric CAD memory.
Authors report better reconstruction fidelity and perceptual quality than baselines on single- and multi-part objects.

selected.title: Frontier Models Reconstruct 3D by Hill-Climbing a 2D Proxy
factual_points: On 98 BenchCAD 1.0 parts, removing self-render viewing produced a score difference of −0.002, with 95% interval ±0.05, at about half API cost.
About five-sixths of roughly 400 inspected runs used rendered silhouette overlap in code.
Perturbing three camera views by 15 degrees lowered 3D score from 0.786 to 0.722 on 100 parts.
Failure examples retain incorrect wall thickness, bore geometry or teeth despite high silhouette agreement.

selected.title: Partnership between ORNL, Boeing advances manufacturing for aircraft parts
factual_points: ORNL and Boeing developed a nearly two-ton steel stamp-form die, six feet tall and four feet wide, printed over eight weeks.
The tooling supports thermoplastic composites and is intended for Boeing participation in NASA HiCAM.
Arc-1 WAAM combines mild-steel structure with stainless-steel working surface and curved thermal channels.
Temporary ribs and 32 simulation iterations compensated warping to within a few millimeters before finishing.
Baker Industries annealed the tool, removed ribs and completed fabrication to Boeing requirements.

selected.title: Label-free physics-informed strength reduction and a neural operator for the reliability of spatially variable slopes
factual_points: Label-free PINN uses virtual-work loss on a finite-element mesh for non-associated Mohr-Coulomb strength reduction.
Safety factors match Abaqus within 2–3% RMS across 52 random fields; shear-band plastic strain remains under-resolved.
The operator is trained only on PINN results; Abaqus is verification only.
Authors report million-field predictions in seconds.
A 3% safety-factor scatter can inflate a 0.001 failure probability up to twofold.

backlog.title: Green-Routed Neural Operators: Physics Determines Where the Network Reads
factual_points: GRNO uses governing equations to choose latent-feature read coordinates rather than treating transport fields only as values. Across five PDE systems it reports lowest mean final error in four over 40 autoregressive steps; interventions test the importance of routing direction and alignment.
backlog.reason: 保存価値は高いが、今回の主題と多様性に照らし採用上位候補に次ぐ。再採用前に原典の完全検証が必要。

backlog.title: SPEAR: A Spectral-Disentangled MoE Neural Operator with Knowledge-Guided Expert Aggregation for Large-Scale PDE Pretraining
factual_points: SPEAR separates low/high-frequency latent features and merges experts using knowledge and routing similarity. Tests span twelve PDE datasets; authors report halving expert count while maintaining or improving accuracy. Pretraining and transfer benchmarks, not industrial CFD validation.
backlog.reason: 保存価値は高いが、今回の主題と多様性に照らし採用上位候補に次ぐ。再採用前に原典の完全検証が必要。

backlog.reason: 保存価値は高いが、今回の主題と多様性に照らし採用上位候補に次ぐ。再採用前に原典の完全検証が必要。

backlog.title: Flow Engineering raises $50M Series B for agentic hardware systems engineering
factual_points: Flow announced $50M Series B at $750M valuation. Its agents connect requirements, CAD, simulation, code and tests; plans include review, branching and evaluation controls. Rivian usage grew from 40 to 1,500 users in seven months, per company. Discovery: traceable systems-engineering workflow is worth monitoring; cycle-time gains are aspirations.
backlog.reason: 保存価値は高いが、今回の主題と多様性に照らし採用上位候補に次ぐ。再採用前に原典の完全検証が必要。

backlog.title: From legacy finite element modeling to explainable simulation: Technical requirements for XAI in computational mechanics
factual_points: Barna Szabó connects explainable simulation to control of model-form and discretization errors, hierarchical finite-element formulations and verification. Spherical-shell examples ground the argument. A methodological requirements paper; it does not establish a general explanation method for black-box neural surrogates.
backlog.reason: 保存価値は高いが、今回の主題と多様性に照らし採用上位候補に次ぐ。再採用前に原典の完全検証が必要。
